The '''HR12 power harness''' was a model of [[Harness/Legends|harness]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was made by [[Galactic Arms]] and sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
